title: Opinionated Compatibility Pack - No Man's Land
description: This Datapack adds new lines for offerings, supporting several mods.
body:
This Data Pack currently adds support for some selection of items from a few mods I may play


<details>
<summary>Click for list of (somewhat) supported mods</summary>

- Cold Sweat
- Create
- Create: Aeronautics
- Create: Power Grid
- Farmer's Delight
- Hex Casting
- Thick Air
- Tide

</details>

Open a PR if you want to contribute, or open an issue if you have a suggestion.
